title: Custom (generated) historical card
description: One card this project implements itself (roadmap item 7): the identity, database row and script behind a `custom-script` coverage in an erratum record. data/custom-cards/c<passcode>.json, next to its script c<passcode>.lua. `retroformats build` generates dist/databases/retro-formats.cdb (one row per record) and dist/scripts/c<passcode>.lua from these; nothing there is hand-edited. Documentation only: the real gate is retroformats/validate.py (`custom-card.*` codes), which also enforces what this schema cannot (that the erratum claims the code, that `desc` is a text the erratum carries, that the script exists).

passcode.description: This project's reserved range (retroformats/model.py RESERVED_PASSCODE_RANGE). The file is named c<passcode>.json.

alias.description: The modern card's passcode: exactly the erratum's modern_card. In a duel the row is that card for every name/code check; copies count under it in deck building.

erratum.description: Id of the erratum record whose custom-script coverage names this passcode.

events.description: The historical state this card implements: the erratum's event set for that coverage ([] = before every recorded event). Empty for a v1 record.

name.description: The row's name, suffixed so it is never mistaken for the modern or an upstream variant.

desc.description: The row's text: copied verbatim from a text the erratum record carries (transcribed there from a cited source), never typed a second time.

cdb.description: The `datas` columns. ot is 8 (SCOPE_ILLEGAL): legal only through a whitelist. All integers.

cdb_provenance.description: Where the statline came from and what was not checked. Free-form documentation.

authorship.description: Who wrote the script and under which licence it is distributed (owner decision 2026-09-27, docs/state.md). The script's header repeats it on fixed lines and the validator rejects a mismatch (custom-card.bad-authorship, custom-card.authorship-header-mismatch).

kind.description: original: this project's own work, MIT, first header line `--SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT`, and measurably different from Project Ignis's script for the alias (tests/engine/test_script_origin.py). derived: adapted from an upstream file and kept under that file's licence.

licence.description: SPDX identifier. MIT for original; for derived, the upstream source's licence (retroformats/model.py CUSTOM_CARD_DERIVABLE_SOURCES: ignis-cardscripts is AGPL-3.0-or-later).

upstream.description: derived only. The header carries `--Upstream: <source url>/blob/<revision>/<path>` and `--<copyright>`.

source.description: Id in data/sources.json of a source a script may be derived from.

path.description: The upstream file, relative to the repository root, e.g. official/c67959180.lua.

revision.description: Must equal the source's pinned revision in data/sources.json.

copyright.description: The upstream's copyright notice as its repository states it.

modified.description: derived only: the notice AGPL-3.0 section 5(a) asks for. The header carries `--Modified by edopro-retro-formats on <date>: <summary>`.

fidelity.description: approximate means the script only approximates the period card; not_reproduced then must say where. History and representability stay separate axes: this record states the second.

not_reproduced.description: What the script does not establish. Required non-empty when fidelity is approximate, empty when exact.

rulings_check.description: The rulings gate (round 035; docs/errata.md, "The rulings gate"). Which period rulings sources were searched, and what each found about the ONE difference the script implements. Missing or incomplete: `custom-card.rulings-check-missing` / `custom-card.rulings-check-malformed` (errors). A `contradicts` finding shown in force needs an `owner_decision`: `custom-card.contradicting-ruling-unaccepted` (error); one whose range in force is not shown is `custom-card.contradicting-ruling-range-unresolved` (a warning, a tracked question for the owner). A schema edit alone enforces nothing: the gate is retroformats/validate.py.

difference.description: One sentence: what the script does that the modern card does not.

checked.description: ISO date the search was done.

searched.description: Every source looked at, including the ones that found nothing. An empty list is not a search.

looked_for.description: What was searched for in that source; for a search that found nothing, this is the record of it.

finding.description: What the source says about the implemented difference. An OCG ruling for a TCG format is does-not-address: it is evidence about the OCG.

passage.description: The passage actually read, quoted briefly. Required for supports and contradicts.

in_force.description: Whether the ruling is shown to have held at the snapshots this record applies at. Required for supports and contradicts. A ruling's date is not its range in force.

in_force_basis.description: Required when in_force is shown: what shows it (a Konami document current at the snapshot, or a later capture of the same text bracketing it).

owner_decision.description: The owner's decision to keep a card that a period ruling shown in force contradicts. Brain records it (docs/state.md); the record names it.
